title: 连接项目云端同步巴别鸟插件
description: 填写你自己的 API Key。WorkBuddy 将凭据保存在本机，并在连接巴别鸟时注入认证请求头。
description_en: Enter your API Key. WorkBuddy stores it locally and injects it into requests to BabelBird.
docLabel: 如何获取巴别鸟 API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get a BabelBird API Key

fields.label: 巴别鸟 API Key
fields.placeholder: 设置 > API秘钥 > 对应 APP > APIKey
fields.placeholder_en: Settings > API keys > your app > APIKey
fields.description: 复制详情页上方的 APIKey，不是 APP Key 或 APP Secret。密钥范围需覆盖目标工程目录。
fields.description_en: Copy APIKey at the top of the app details, not APP Key or APP Secret. Grant access to your project folder.
